lossy_mapping: [.89,0,-.89,0] and [.91,0,-.91,0] both choose code 1 and reconstruct [1,0,-1,0]. A decoder receiving only that ID and fixed codebook cannot identify which original was supplied.
conditioned_generation_boundary: Reconstruction consumes x and derives q(x). A learned conditional generator must instead obtain z from its condition c (e.g. model p(z|c)) when reference x is absent. The demonstrated q(x)->lookup path never evaluates this condition-to-code mapping. This is a distinction in learned generative tasks, not a claim that hand-coded synthesis is impossible.
